newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Glickman to focus on Latam trade in 1997.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Glickman to focus on Latam trade in 1997.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department Secretary Dan Glickman Thursday said he would focus on broadening agricultural trade with Latin America in 1997 and hoped to pay a visit to the region.

"I intend to give personal attention to Latin America this year," Glickman told a news conference to recap 1996. "I'm going to try make a trip there, not only Mexico but certainly Brazil, Argentina, Chile, other countries that are potentially very big markets for U.S. agricultural products."
